title: LanG 2.0: Energy-Efficient Agentic AI for Semi-Automated Security Operations at Scale
abstract: arXiv:2610.41072v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Security operations centers (SOCs) need to turn terabytes of alerts, logs and flows into trusted, affordable decisions to unveil hidden threats. We present LanG 2.0, an agentic system that detects threats, correlates evidence and writes rules, investigating whether small local models can replace frontier models affordably and safely when structural safeguards, not model accuracy, provide the guarantees. It incorporates entity-anchored correlation, human approval of rule changes and a tamper-evident ledger. Tests span eight flow datasets from five networks, real XDR alerts and multistage campaigns. Against its predecessor, campaign correlation precision rises from 18.75% to 51.81%, and rule acceptance from at most 60.00% to 98.33%. Against Claude Opus 5.5, scoring flows against each network's normal traffic detects attacks on unseen networks at 73.42% F1 without false positives, versus 58.10% with 49.00% false positives, for at least 650

translated_title: LanG 2.0：面向大规模半自动化安全运营的节能智能体AI
translated_abstract: 安全运营中心（SOC）需要将数TB的警报、日志和流量数据转化为可信且经济实惠的决策，以揭示隐藏的威胁。我们提出了LanG 2.0，一个能够检测威胁、关联证据并编写规则的智能体系统，旨在探究当由结构性保障措施（而非模型精度）来提供安全保证时，小型本地模型能否以经济且安全的方式取代前沿大模型。该系统融合了实体锚定关联、规则变更的人工审批机制以及防篡改账本。测试覆盖了来自五个网络的八个流量数据集、真实的XDR警报以及多阶段攻击活动。与其前代版本相比，攻击活动关联精确率从18.75%提升至51.81%，规则接受率从最高60.00%提升至98.33%。与Claude Opus 5.5相比，通过将流量与各网络的正常流量进行比对评分，在对未见过网络上的攻击检测中达到73.42%的F1分数且零误报，而Claude Opus 5.5仅为58.10%的F1分数且误报率高达49.00%，同时能耗至少降低650倍（原文此处截断）。
tldr: LanG 2.0通过结构性保障机制（实体锚定关联、人工审批和防篡改账本）使小型本地模型能够安全地取代前沿大模型，在能耗大幅降低650倍以上的同时，显著提升了威胁关联精确率和规则接受率。
en_tdlr: LanG 2.0 demonstrates that small local models, empowered by structural safeguards (entity-anchored correlation, human approval, and tamper-evident ledger), can safely replace frontier models in security operations, improving correlation precision and rule acceptance while reducing energy consumption by at least 650x.
